title: Require exact-current canonical Revised field metadata
outcome: Both reviewers found that the new defaulted Revised fields vector silently accepts prior-build canonical event shapes and renders a generic fallback. Preserve schema marker 1 while refusing incompatible durable shapes before mutation rather than adding compatibility.
acceptance: A runtime-derived missing-fields canonical event fixture is refused before mutation with the generic different-build behavior; current revised events retain per-field history.

completion.summary: Per Fable ruling 567, new persisted Revised metadata was removed entirely. Field words are derived uniformly from adjacent verified canonical planning snapshots; first-native restored revisions use the immutable restore record. Coverage passes for all eight changed fields, older snapshots outside the displayed tail, no-op revisions, absent extra metadata and healthy stores.
